    - 'heading "RELATION GRAPH (A = {1, 2, 3, 4}) Drag to draw arrows" [level=2]':
      - text: "RELATION GRAPH (A = {1, 2, 3, 4}) Drag to draw arrows"
      - img
    - img "Directed relation graph":
      - button "Element 1": "1"
      - button "Element 2": "2"
      - button "Element 3": "3"
      - button "Element 4": "4"
    - text: "Ordered pairs in R:"
    - status: "{(1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 2), (2, 4), (3, 2), (3, 3), (3, 4), (4, 4)}"
    - heading "RELATION MATRIX Mᵣ" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Rows = first element, Columns = second element
    - text: A 1 2 3 4 1
    - button "Toggle pair 1, 1": "1"
    - button "Toggle pair 1, 2": "1"
    - button "Toggle pair 1, 3": "1"
    - button "Toggle pair 1, 4": "0"
    - text: "2"
    - button "Toggle pair 2, 1": "0"
    - button "Toggle pair 2, 2": "1"
    - button "Toggle pair 2, 3": "0"
    - button "Toggle pair 2, 4": "1"
    - text: "3"
    - button "Toggle pair 3, 1": "0"
    - button "Toggle pair 3, 2": "1"
    - button "Toggle pair 3, 3": "1"
    - button "Toggle pair 3, 4": "1"
    - text: "4"
    - button "Toggle pair 4, 1": "0"
    - button "Toggle pair 4, 2": "0"
    - button "Toggle pair 4, 3": "0"
    - button "Toggle pair 4, 4": "1"
    - text: 1 = (i, j) ∈ R 0 = (i, j) ∉ R
    - heading "RELATION PROPERTY DIAGNOSTICS" [level=2]:
      - text: RELATION PROPERTY DIAGNOSTICS
      - img
    - article:
      - img
      - heading "Reflexive" [level=3]
      - emphasis: (a, a) ∈ R for all a ∈ A
      - paragraph: All diagonal pairs are in R.
      - strong: "TRUE"
    - article:
      - img
      - heading "Symmetric" [level=3]
      - emphasis: (a, b) ∈ R ⇒ (b, a) ∈ R
      - paragraph: (1, 2) is present, but (2, 1) is missing.
      - strong: "FALSE"
    - article:
      - img
      - heading "Antisymmetric" [level=3]
      - emphasis: (a, b) ∈ R and (b, a) ∈ R ⇒ a = b
      - paragraph: No distinct elements are related both ways.
      - strong: "TRUE"
    - article:
      - img
      - heading "Transitive" [level=3]
      - emphasis: (a, b) ∈ R and (b, c) ∈ R ⇒ (a, c) ∈ R
      - paragraph: (1, 2) and (2, 4) need (1, 4).
      - strong: "FALSE"
